prose: Basis: Reuters blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Anthropic's post-IPO governance will keep its Public Benefit Corporation status, and its seven co-founders will retain 50.1% voting control through a single Class F share. The structure is designed to survive the public markets: outside investors get economics, while control over the company's direction - and its safety commitments - stays with the founders.
